blurb: Guests can explore the 4.4km Harbourwalk with views of the harbour and seawall, enjoy local culinary and cultural experiences, and take boat tours including luxury captained cruises and electric harbour launches. The waterfront features shops, dining, art murals, and historic vessels like the Bluenose II and HMCS Sackville. Various operators offer sightseeing tours, sailing, and wildlife viewing on the water.
